metadata.availability: Published Rpath port snapshot; materially differs from the accepted native EwE configuration. Static source budget checks pass. Native database unavailable; detritus-routing import restrictions and loader departures retained. No project researcher approval or Ecopath PPR coefficients/matching.
metadata.coverage_note: whole North Sea model footprint; exact overlap with LME boundary not measured
